text:
Alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock remediation owners, update dashboards, and decide on SLO tweaks. who can take what?
Maria: I can own the remediation owner rotation doc and the timeline. proposing 2-week owners with overlap. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Tim: +1 for rotations. Also we should look at throughput SLO — looks like bursts are causing the errorbudget to spike. can we bump alert sensitivity?
Jamie: I’ll take dashboard changes. will prioritize the per-route latency and p95 heatmap. link to current dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/slo-dashboard (needs extra widget for GPU queue length).
Alex: thanks. Maria, timeline sounds good. please create a tiny playbook with owners + handoff steps. include runbook link.
Maria: added a draft in the doc: https://redwood.docs/plays/remediation-rotation-draft — owners = @Tim (week1), @Jamie (week2), @Alex (shadow). handoff checklist has required logs and sanity queries.
Tim: for throughput SLO, proposal: keep latency SLO at 200ms p95 but add a throughput SLO for tail concurrency — target 95th percentile of concurrent requests <= 120 per GPU pod. if exceeded, trigger autoscale override.
Alex: explicit proposal noted. we should surface this to product SLA owners before finalizing. Maria, can you schedule a 30m sync with @Product-ops Friday?
Maria: scheduled Friday 10:00 PT — invite sent.
Jamie: dashboard plan: add a new panel showing concurrent requests by pod, errorbudget burn rate, and rolling 1h p95. will also add annotation for incident window. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Tim: alert thresholds: current p95 alert at 180ms triggers too often during controlled bursts. suggest moving to 220ms and creating a burst-detection alert that watches queue depth
Alex: ok let's standardize: change p95 alert to 220ms, create new alert `throughput-queue-depth` using metric `gpu_queue_length` > 80 for 2m. ops team to validate.
sre-bot: deployment noted — updating alert rule `p95-latency` to 220ms in staging at 1765005600.
Jamie: quick question — do we want automatic rollback to cheaper model variants on sustained burn? that helped last incident but affected quality.
Maria: tradeoff noted. product needs to sign off. add as agenda item in Friday sync.
Tim: action items recap: (1) Maria — create owner rotation doc + schedule (done + scheduled); (2) Jamie — dashboard widgets + annotation (ETA EOD tomorrow); (3) Alex — coordinate product sign-off on throughput SLO & fallback policy; (4) Tim — draft alert definitions and test scenarios; (5) ops — validate autoscale override thresholds.
Alex: thanks everyone. set a reminder — check-in thread next Tuesday to confirm dashboard & alert rollout. :thumbsup:
Jamie: noted. I’ll post screenshots when widgets are up.
Tim: will add unit test for the alert config in the infra repo.
Maria: closing loop — I'll attach the remediation owner spreadsheet to the doc and ping the SLAs channel once product signs off.
Alex: perfect. if anyone hits blockers, call it out here or ping me directly.
